verdict.rationale: SAM.gov offers first-party REST APIs for entities, opportunities, exclusions, contracts, the federal hierarchy and assistance listings. They use key-based authentication, dedicated System Accounts for machine access, JSON/CSV output, pagination and bulk extracts, so unattended scripts and CI jobs can run without the web UI. A downloadable OpenAPI spec is documented, though probes did not find it at standard well-known paths. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific automation guidance, documented details of rate limits and the friction of approving System Accounts, the OpenAPI spec at a discoverable machine path, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
